message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout that turned my cozy evening into a little adventure. As I fumbled around for flashlights, I couldn’t help but feel a bit smug—I had been insisting we stock up on power banks and lanterns, while my husband rolled his eyes. We ended up sitting on the couch, phones charged and a warm glow from our trusty lantern, sharing stories by candlelight (okay, okay, maybe just the lantern light!). It's funny how these little moments can remind us to be a bit prepared for the unexpected. Have you ever had a blackout that turned into an unexpected family night?
